improvement: French reported-end-date follow-ups using ‘cette année’ now retain selected FONGIM, World Bank or EU project identifiers. The relative period is frozen to the current UTC calendar year before fresh source retrieval.
reproduced_before: ‘Lesquels de ces projets ont une date de fin cette année ?’ and its clôture variant returned no structured resolution even though the equivalent English follow-up and the date engine already supported current-calendar-year selection.

qualification.fresh_retrieval_guard: Only selected source identifiers, a previously established active-only constraint, and the current UTC calendar year carry forward. Prior dates, statuses, reach claims and other source-family identifiers are excluded.
qualification.period_guard: French current-year wording becomes one explicit UTC calendar year. Compound, conflicting and analytical periods continue through semantic resolution.
qualification.ambiguity_guard: A mixed roster without an explicitly named source family remains ambiguous.
qualification.api_guard: The French current-calendar-year path skips semantic rewriting and invokes one fresh research lookup in the API test.

deployment.blocker: Exact-SHA deployment to the authorised V4 test service requires a signed-in dashboard session. Generic deployment remains unsafe because the configured source branch is older and divergent.
deployment.next_action: Deploy published_code_commit to V4 test only, then live-test French current-year and English/French next-year follow-ups, explicit ranges, mixed-roster source selection, active-only continuity, fresh citations, FONGIM selected ID 664, and Mali 815 to Gao 44.

rollback.database: No schema or data change. Retain the existing additive evaluation schema and reviewed source facts.

continuity.do_not_repeat: Do not rebuild the active-only, empty-subset, French catalogue, mixed-source, explicit-range, next-calendar-year or French current-calendar-year fixes. Reconcile the latest candidate branch and service before exact-SHA deployment.
continuity.if_deployment_still_blocked: Continue the next bounded Q-006 topic-change or supported-time-filter continuity case after reproducing it.

preservation: Accepted PADEL publication, FONGIM selection, geography, source catalogue, response, dossier and account behavior retained; no database, source record, service configuration, access, production or administration change.
limitations: Only recognised reported-end-date follow-up wording and unambiguous French current-calendar-year forms use this deterministic path.
Long or truncated rosters, more than twelve identifiers, unnamed mixed-source sets, compound periods and analytical cross-source questions continue through semantic resolution.
No live acceptance, actual-database qualification or full model benchmark was performed.
spending: All qualification was local and made no external model or research calls.
